evidence.title: ai-animate: Animated UI components for AI apps

name: ai-animate
summary: Open-source React components for AI apps: 60+ animated text effects, cinematic reveals, image transitions and AI state indicators.
description: An MIT npm package (@ai-animate/core) of drop-in animated components for AI products: typewriter, streaming and thinking text; cinematic and video/broadcast text like lower thirds, captions and countdowns; image reveals and scene wrappers. Works in React 18+, Next.js and Remotion for AI chat frontends, landing pages and video production.
contains: 60+ animated components: text animations, cinematic text, video/broadcast, cards, media, scene
AI state indicators: StreamText token streaming, ThinkingText, CountUp
video set: lower third, subtitles, chapter marker, countdown, waveform, timecode
@ai-animate/core npm package, MIT, tree-shakeable, peer deps React >=18
works with React, Next.js (App Router + Pages Router) and Remotion
